verdict.rationale: Temporal's docs describe Signals/Queries/Updates for interacting with a running workflow and durable agent-loop patterns (calling LLMs/tools), but there is no evidence of a mechanism for pushing live, incremental progress or token-level streaming from a workflow to a frontend — Queries are pull/poll-based, not a live stream. missing for 10: any documented streaming/subscription API (e.g., websocket, SSE) for real-time progress or token updates, and any example wiring workflow state to a live frontend feed.
